notes: Team-readiness pass before sharing. Fixed the dead «+ موقع جديد» button on sites.html, removed the last unbadged fake data (calendar + HR roster), unified the topbar navigation (logo → welcome.html everywhere; الإجراءات → automations.html), made landing.html the canonical entry with a clear login CTA that routes to today.html post-auth, added loading skeletons to CRM/Mail, neutralized dead placeholder buttons on spine.html, and deleted four orphaned legacy pages.
changelog: sites.html: wired the «+ موقع جديد» button to the real add/manage-sites UI (ArsanSites.openSitesUI from sites.js) — previously had no click handler; admin add/delete now refreshes the zone grid on close
sites.js: fixed empty-state bug (single-quoted string rendered literal ${isAdmin?…}); recolored add-site button from legacy #bf9b30 to #C9A961

calendar.html: removed 4 fabricated demo events (اجتماع الإدارة الأسبوعي، مراجعة الميزانية Q2، …) — empty calendar now shows honest empty-states across day/agenda/sidebar until real events exist or a provider is connected
hr.html: employee roster now shows a 'بيانات تجريبية / DEMO' banner when falling back to seed data (attendance & payroll were already badged)

nav: الإجراءات topbar link unified to automations.html on today.html + sites.html (was index.html / dashboard.html respectively); dashboard.html's إجراءات item left intact because dashboard-tabs.js intercepts it to open an overlay pane (not navigation)

nav: brand logo now points to welcome.html on every tool page (automations, calendar, crm, mail, hr, integrations, exec, depts-admin, spine, landing) + made dashboard.html's topbar logo clickable — previously inconsistent (spine.html vs welcome.html vs none)

landing.html: now the canonical entry — primary CTA is 'تسجيل الدخول' which skips the OS boot and routes through auth-gate to today.html (post-auth hub); signup wizard finish also routes through login; 'ابدأ مجاناً' demoted to secondary
crm.html + mail.html: added shimmer loading skeletons in the content region / message list so slow connections no longer flash blank before the API resolves
spine.html: replaced the dead تصدير / + جديد fallback buttons on placeholder modules with a non-interactive 'قريباً · SOON' indicator; brand logo → welcome.html
removed orphaned legacy pages: today-old.html, today-old2.html, today-old3.html, spine-old.html (unlinked, stale navs)

dashboard.html: edit-mode toolbar (تحرير مباشر / رفع ملف / توليد بالذكاء) + inline-edit outline & caret recolored from navy #3D5A80/#293F5C to Spine gold #C9A961 / ink #A8893A; mind-map SVG nodes intentionally left navy
admin-toolbar.js: 4 legacy #8B6F00 spots (dept-modal h2, focus border, .btn-primary, new-section save button) → #C9A961
cache-bust.js: 3 legacy #8B6F00 spots (update-banner gradient, banner button, toast) → #C9A961
settings.js: department color-input default value #8B6F00 → #C9A961 (remaining #8B6F00 are dead var() fallbacks, never rendered)

mail.html: removed seedDemo() fake-inbox fallback (5 fabricated messages); empty folders now show a folder-aware empty-state (icon + title + hint) and a 'لا نتائج' state when search/filter matches nothing

crm.html: removed seedDemo() fake data (5 companies, 6 contacts, 5 deals, 4 tickets); all 5 surfaces (pipeline, companies, contacts, deals, tickets) now render honest empty-states, plus a shared 'لا نتائج مطابقة' search state

sites.html: now hybrid — fetches /api/sites from the worker and maps real sites onto the zone cards; falls back to the hardcoded demo zones only when the API is empty/unreachable, with the hero label switching to 'بيانات تجريبية · DEMO DATA'; site detail shows 'لا نشاط مُسجّل' when a real site has no feed

integrations.js: connect('slack') now POSTs the webhook URL to the worker /api/slack-webhook (writes slack_webhook_v1) with bearer token, so server-side Slack notifications actually fire; falls back to local-only save with a clear toast if the server rejects (non-admin) or is unreachable
integrations.js: added getAuthToken() helper (non-disruptive token read — no forced login redirect)
integrations.html: inbound Webhooks URL box relabeled with a gold 'معاينة فقط — قريباً' badge + a note that the endpoint is not yet active on the server
integrations.js: each internal Flow toggle now carries a gold 'قريباً' badge to signal the toggles are cosmetic (persist to localStorage only, no backend wiring yet)

automations.html: all 6 placeholder alert() stubs (newAutomation, useTemplate, addReminder, addRecurring, addEmailRule, syncFromHR) replaced with a gold toast 'هذه الميزة ستكون متاحة قريباً' matching the integrations.js toast style
automations.html: gold 'قريباً' badge added to the 5 placeholder tabs (Workflows, Reminders, Recurring, Email Rules, Auto-Archive); Birthdays, Activity Log, stat counters and toggles left as-is
hr.html: attendance tab now shows a gold dimmed demo-banner 'بيانات تجريبية — الحضور الفعلي سيتوفر قريباً'
hr.html: payroll tab now shows a gold dimmed demo-banner 'بيانات تجريبية — الرواتب محسوبة تقديرياً' before the payroll table
hr.html: archive upload (📤 رفع ملف) and download (⬇) buttons now show the honest message 'رفع الملفات سيكون متاحاً قريباً' instead of the bare 'تنزيل'

spine-api.js: FIX — added missing fmtNum() to the SpineAPI export (en-US grouped number formatting). Resolves the 'A.fmtNum is not a function' crash that was breaking the stats strip + payroll/employee tables on hr.html and the pipeline/deal values on crm.html
Audit note: integrations.html handlers confirmed fully defined in integrations.js — no broken/undefined onclick handlers (corrects an earlier audit assumption)
